layout: A patched dark-asphalt road runs along the picture foreground with an open kerb drain at its inner edge. Immediately behind the drain a narrow concrete pavement runs left–right; the compact vending bay with a blue awning sits at the left end of the pavement and then the pavement continues right alongside a pale weathered concrete boundary wall with a leaf-green building surface above it and recessed shop shutters further right. Utility poles and overhead cables run along the pavement side; a modest two-storey concrete building with a balcony sits above the vending bay. The anchor spot for cameras is on the road side facing the pavement area where the conversation takes place—just to the right of the vending bay—so the pavement, drain and boundary wall are the consistent landmarks.
empty: Vending bay space at frame left beneath the blue awning, where the food three-wheeler stands in scenes — when empty it is a compact concrete bay with a slightly recessed patch of pavement and a clear gap beside the open kerb drain.

Family car stop position on the road in front of the pavement conversation point, facing screen right with its pavement-side rear door nearest the curb — when empty it is a section of patched asphalt directly adjacent to the drain and pavement.

views.what: Outside, placed a little in front of and to the left of the vehicle's nose, looking back across the front and the pavement-side service bay. The maroon front and left wheel in the near-left, the curved windscreen and black vinyl roof across the top, and the pavement-side rear compartment and open hinged hatch on the right; faded paint, small dents and worn silver metal are visible across the body.

layout: A compact maroon three-wheeler with a small front cab (single driver seat) and a rear service compartment on the pavement side (Side A).
